verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a Fireflies mobile app or in-person recording. The product's documented capture is a meeting bot that joins calls, plus an uploadAudio API mutation, which is only a developer building block. The dictation feature turns the user's own voice into text and is not conversation recording. Meeting search exists, but without a documented mobile capture path the story is not delivered.

support.subject: As a founder, I can record and transcribe in-person conversations from a mobile app, and those notes land in the same searchable workspace
